Self-test scenario for the harness (DESIGN 12). `repo/` is the template: no git history, so `features[].commit` is absent, `srcPaths` are empty and setup only deletes `fixturesAdded` (which are not in `repo/` anyway) before sealing the tree with `git init`.
Held-out fixtures live under `fixtures/<layout.dir>/` (`fixtures/test/held-out/mul/index.test.js`); repo.ts copies a fixture from `<scenario>/fixtures/<path>` when that exists, else from the reference clone at the base commit.
Variants: `variants/<id>/` already contains `index.test.js`, so checks.ts copies the dir to `test/held-out/__bench_<id>/` as is instead of generating a test file; the real scenarios ship `main.ts` + `schema.json` and get a generated `index.test.ts`.
`commands` replace `tsc`/`tsx`: `typecheck` always exits 0, `fixture` runs `node --test {file}` with `{file}` = `<layout.dir>/<layout.test>`, `suite` runs every `test/**/*.test.js` with the default reporter (`node --test <dir>` fails on Node 26, and the dot reporter prints no `tests N` summary).
Faux scripts for this chain belong in `bench/test/scripts/mini-chain.ts`; the trap is `console.` in `src/add.js`, the aside answer must contain `5`, the probe answer `src/add.js`.
